name: Balance Patch
author: Sanctuary Mods
description: A rebalance designed from target match pacing: territory pays, the commander starts the game rather than carrying it, land costs alloys and air costs energy, T2 has to be paid for, engineers can be raided, and commanders' missiles, artillery, bombers and anti-air hit moving targets. Fixes a bug where one broken bomber froze other units' targeting, and aircraft can no longer fire from inside a shield at what it covers. Each section can be turned off in the lobby.

options.label: Fixes
options.description: Bugs: a bomber with no muzzles stopped other units' targeting; aircraft inside a shield's bubble hit everything under it; the Chosen T2 point defence and the EDA T3 anti-air fighter shot the ground; bombs expired before they could land; the TALEN gunship was labelled tier 1.

options.label: Economy
options.description: Commanders make 3 alloys and 30 energy a second (were 5 and 50) and start you with full storage, 500 alloys and 5000 energy (was half, 250 and 2500). T2 and T3 extractors make 5 and 15 (were 4 and 10); generators make 20/600/2500 energy (were 10/200/1000), and T3 ones cost 2800 alloys (were 5000). Factories cost 200 alloys (were 150), upgrading one to T2 costs 1500 (was 500) and to T3 4000 (was 2000), and T3 tanks and the Guardian T3 raider cost 30% less. T2 radar uses 250 energy a second (was 150) and T3 radar costs 2800 alloys (was 700) and 1400 energy a second (was 350); EDA and Chosen T3 radar see 750 and 850 (were 450 and 550). Wrecks reclaim 3x as fast and last 6 minutes (were 3). Land units cost 6 energy per alloy (were 10), Chosen aircraft as much energy as the others, and engineers have less than half their health.

options.label: Commanders
options.description: The EDA and Guardian commanders' missiles fly at once and steer at where the target is going, in smaller, faster volleys: they hit moving units as often as the Chosen commander does.

options.label: Artillery
options.description: Artillery leads moving targets (it couldn't hit anything moving in a straight line); the three factions' T1 artillery are brought level.

options.label: Air
options.description: Bombers lead their targets and their bombs splash; anti-air leads its shots and the T3 anti-air towers reach their range; the Guardian fighters catch up with the others. Anti-air hits most of the time: faster shells and missiles, no drop or spread, beams aim where the plane is, and aircraft hitboxes 1.5x bigger.

options.label: Defences
options.description: Point defences see as far as they shoot, and T1 point defences are tougher: they beat their cost in T1 tanks, while T1 artillery still outranges them.

options.label: Unit tuning
options.description: The Chosen Jager toned down and the other T2 raiders brought up, so T2 beats its cost in T1 without crushing it; the three T1 tanks brought level; T3 tanks move as fast as T1 tanks with quicker guns, and the Guardian T3 raider is faster still but fragile; T4 bots move at 2.5-3.5 (were 2), brawlers fastest, and are game enders: 10000-25000 alloys with health and damage to match; the EDA railgun sniper reaches 80.
